_instructions: Use this template to submit a media asset (illustration, diagram, photo, video) for an exercise. Copy to community/submissions/media-<exercise-slug>-<asset-type>.json and open a Pull Request. The asset itself should be attached to the PR or linked via source_url.
contributor: REQUIRED: Your GitHub username or display name
exercise_slug: REQUIRED: Slug of the exercise this media depicts. Example: 'barbell-bench-press'
asset_type: REQUIRED: One of: illustration | diagram | photo | animation | video — 'illustration' is a drawn/vector image; 'diagram' shows muscle activation or movement mechanics; 'photo' is a photograph; 'animation' is an animated GIF or similar; 'video' is a video file or embed
source_url: REQUIRED: Publicly accessible URL where the asset can be downloaded or reviewed. If attaching to the PR, use the GitHub attachment URL after uploading.
file_format: REQUIRED: File extension without the dot. Examples: 'svg', 'png', 'jpg', 'gif', 'mp4', 'webm'

dimensions.width_px: OPTIONAL: Width in pixels for raster images. Leave null for SVG.
dimensions.height_px: OPTIONAL: Height in pixels for raster images. Leave null for SVG.

license_spdx: REQUIRED: SPDX license identifier. Must be one of: CC0-1.0 | CC-BY-4.0 | CC-BY-SA-4.0 — only open licenses are accepted. Preferred: CC0-1.0
attribution_text: REQUIRED if license is not CC0-1.0. The exact attribution string that must accompany this asset when used. For CC0-1.0 assets this can be an empty string.
original_author: REQUIRED: Full name or handle of the original creator of this asset. If you created it, put your name/username.
is_original_work: REQUIRED: true or false — 'true' means you created this asset yourself and are releasing it under the stated license. 'false' means it is a third-party asset you are nominating for inclusion (maintainers will verify licensing independently).
depicts_view: OPTIONAL: The view angle or perspective this asset shows. Examples: 'lateral', 'anterior', 'posterior', 'isometric', 'top-down', 'sequence'
depicts_phase: OPTIONAL: Which phase of the exercise this asset depicts. Examples: 'start', 'midpoint', 'end', 'full-sequence'
notes: OPTIONAL: Any additional information about the asset — quality notes, recommended usage context, known limitations, or anything a reviewer should know.
